name: fintech-ledger
description: Personal Fintech Dashboard — expense tracking with predictive analytics

scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n api,web -c yellow,cyan "npm:dev:server" "npm:dev:client"
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @fintech/server && npm run build -w @fintech/client
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck -w @fintech/server && npm run typecheck -w @fintech/client
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test -w @fintech/server
